claim: The NINDS Multiple Sclerosis Common Data Elements page is an external public resource for MS clinical-study data standards, CRF modules, and recommended data elements.
future_grounding_route: CDE fields can inform future intake-schema mapping or data-request templates, but any data-standard adoption must be implemented and tested separately.
project_use: Clinical-study data-standard context for future cohort intake and public navigation.
resource_name: NINDS Multiple Sclerosis Common Data Elements
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: MS-specific clinical research data-standard and CRF-module vocabulary not represented in the repository's current validation schemas.
why_unverifiable: The CDE recommendations and committee process are external; the project can use them only as context unless it implements and tests specific schema mappings.
